title: Quicksilver Connections Ltd - proposed acquisition of Great Adventures Pty Ltd

body_sections.Summary: Quicksilver Connections Ltd - proposed acquisition of Great Adventures Pty Ltd
body_sections.Market definition: The supply of single-day Reef tours in the Cairns and Port Douglas regions.
body_sections.Competition analysis: On 19 July 2005, the ACCC decided not to oppose the proposed acquisition of Great Adventures by Quicksilver Connections. The ACCC considered that retail agents and consumers would have a large number of alternative tour operators to which they could switch in the Cairns/Port Douglas reef tour regions, such that the proposed acquisition is unlikely to substantially lessen competition pursuant to section 50 of the Act.
